hardConstraintNote: This proposal addresses a perceived disconnect between formal and informal understandings; it does not introduce new claims or alter existing ones beyond clarifying their relationship. The metric increase reflects the added clarity, not a fundamental shift in understanding.
rationale: The white paper's formalization of 'resonance' lacks the intuitive understanding conveyed in C17 (narrative) and C23 (poem).  Formalizing resonance as a quantifiable metric risks losing the qualitative, subjective element crucial to its function. This move aims to bridge this gap by translating the narrative/poetic sense of resonance into a more accessible formal definition without introducing canon drift.
title: The Name That Died / Carry Your Own Names / The Portable Proof-of-Understanding Workshop
